handoffs.what: hesmi-M4 effect half: make Hesmi Shadeprint's vfxTint #6C5BA8 reach her shadows. In content/vfx.json add an 'element' colour layer (or switch the shadow body/edge colour ref to 'element') in hesmi_a1_shadow, hesmi_ult_shadow and hesmi_ult_shard. Keep the team rings on 'team'. Base keeps its signature violet through elementOf's fallback, if element falls back to the signature.

SUK-M5 effect half: make Sukri Shadeprint's vfxTint #6C5BA8 reach the kit. Add 'element' refs (or route skinTint into signature) for the cup motes, the Mote Toss bolt, the Draw Near pull and the Gather In flare in the sukri_* defs of content/vfx.json. Keep team rings on 'team'. All 16 sukri_* defs have 0 element refs today, and every Sukri cast has its own windupVfx, so the generic element wind-up never plays.

marund-M2 sim half: give Domefall's self-dash a per-effect arc in src/sim/movement.ts (self-dashes get arc 0 at l.131; knockbacks already use KNOCK_ARC). Use a peak of about 0.5-0.6 m, not 0.8-1.0: the new domefall_leap clip already lifts the hips 0.50 m at 40 % of the dash, and the two add up. Keep the shadow on the floor.

marund-M2 content: in content/fighters/marund.json, ult recast/dash effect (the 'present' block next to vfx marund_ult_leap, ~l.540), change present.anim from 'dash' to 'domefall_leap'. Add "domefall_leap": "domefall_leap" to art.clips if the client resolves clips through that map. The GLB already carries the clip (20 f, 0.667 s; meta role dash, apex_t 0.40, slam_t 0.82).

marund-M2 playback: src/render/actors.ts maps clip time to dash progress only when role === 'dash' (~l.1037). Apply the same mapping to any clip played in the dash state (v.state === 'dash', e.g. role 'domefall_leap'), so the leap's apex and slam land on the dash's progress. Optionally flare the cap windows at the apex (t 0.40) as the warning beat.

Optional, Marund sockets: the brief names weapon_tip x_maul_head. The swing probe's glint currently lands on prop.R (the grip; dR 0) because Marund has no maul-head socket. If CW6 adds an x_maul_head bone in a later rebuild, map 'weapon_tip': 'x_maul_head' in content/fighters/marund.json art.sockets.

result.summary: CW6 fails round 1. Verdict written to _design/reviews/fixwaves/CW6_verify1.json (commit 2b813f65, pushed). The model and animation fixes that landed hold up when re-measured: Hesmi M1 and M2 (hood vs bands dE76 8.6 x3), Sukri M2 and M3 (wraps C 11.7-12.6, see-through cup, distinct attack clips), Marund M1 and M3, Odrum M1 (16.9 % vertical, modelled), M2 and the crown (R3 11.4 cm on 3/3 skins), Tunlan C2 and c4 (hat step <= 0.232 m even at the 2.2x playback cap, with a >= 4-frame settle), and Dunsom's idle and recall. All 24 GLBs pass the three.js load test. What fails: none of the 8 fighters has staged per-skin cards (Marund, Odrum, Rishal and Tunlan cards date from Oct 28-29; Ilsheta's are uncommitted and in progress). Ilsheta's skins were not rebuilt. Dunsom's hat ramp averages 8.5 L* (needs >= 10). Marund's ult is still not airborne in game. The Hesmi and Sukri Shadeprint effect halves wait on CW1. The Ilsheta and Rishal motion fixes landed only through wip sync, with no CW6 commit or review. No fighter reaches the par bar with its majors closed. No sensitivity blocker was seen in the new renders; Rishal's blank slit visor is noted as a watch item.
